_: PHYSICAL-DEVICE EVIDENCE LEDGER for local-first background removal (local BG §8, §12). Compilation is not validation and a mocked unit test is not a device, so a release may not ship native code that has never produced a real cutout on real hardware. Each entry is keyed by `native_fingerprint` -- a hash of that platform's native sources plus docs/bg/local_cutout_compatibility.json -- so ANY change to the engine, the plugin, the registration, the pinned ML Kit client, the Vision revision or the validated toolchain invalidates prior evidence and forces the matrix to run again. Append entries with `python3 scripts/verify_local_cutout_release.py --record-device-evidence ...` after a session; never hand-edit a fingerprint to make a build pass.
